operation.description:
List any syntax errors that are detected in the CODEOWNERS
file.

For more information about the correct CODEOWNERS syntax,
see "[About code owners](https://docs.github.com/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/about-code-owners)."

parameters.description: A branch, tag or commit name used to determine which version of the CODEOWNERS file to use. Default: the repository's default branch (e.g. `main`)
parameters.name: ref

errors.message:
Invalid pattern on line 3: Did you mean `**/*.rb`?

  ***/*.rb @monalisa
  ^

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/codeowners-errors.description: A list of errors found in a repo's CODEOWNERS file

column.description: The column number where this errors occurs.

line.description: The line number where this errors occurs.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error, combining information from multiple fields, laid out for display in a monospaced typeface (for example, a command-line setting).

path.description: The path of the file where the error occured.

source.description: The contents of the line where the error occurs.

suggestion.description: Suggested action to fix the error. This will usually be `null`, but is provided for some common errors.
suggestion.example: The pattern `/` will never match anything, did you mean `*` instead?

#/components/schemas/codeowners-errors.title: CODEOWNERS errors
